name: multiversa-browser-bridge
description: Time-boxed local control bridge between an authenticated Chromium tab and Multiversa.

interface.shortDescription: Control one authorized browser tab from the local CLI.
interface.longDescription: A local-first browser bridge. One click authorizes a Gmail, Hotmart or ManyChat tab for 30 minutes; the CLI can then inspect, reload, click, download and fill semantic controls without reading or exporting cookies.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Multiversa Browser Bridge to operate only a time-boxed, user-authorized Gmail, Hotmart or ManyChat tab. Never ask for, read, or export browser cookies, passwords, OTPs or session tokens.
